note: Initial run had 4,815,204 chars / 436K tokens but ~73% was Claude Code system-injection records (<task-notification>, <bash-input>, etc.) wrapped as role:user. Filter added; numbers above are post-filter.

interpretation: user / spike / srmech / research / docs / notebook = project canon vocabulary; lexicon reflects work focus

Bag (Class M bundle, position-free) cleanly separates same-meaning from different-meaning cohorts. Within-cohort mean ~10x between-cohort mean. Sequence (with position-bind) shows weak separation as predicted — same tokens in varied order produce near-orthogonal sequence fingerprints. Supports holographic-projection reading: meaning carried in bag; order is the projection-specific variation.

anomaly: Cohort `identity_not_implementation` shows within-bag mean only 0.046 — far below other cohorts (range 0.10-0.41). Paraphrases use varied syntactic structure with minimal shared content tokens (no single repeating noun phrase). Stop-word-drop is part of this: 'is', 'y', 'x' are dropped or near-meaningless as 1-char tokens.
investigation: Inspected per-cohort token sets — `identity_not_implementation` paraphrases share only the word 'identity' across all four sentences after stopword drop. Other cohorts share 3-5 content tokens.
verdict: NOT-AN-ENCODER-BUG. Concept-level paraphrase using disjoint vocabulary is genuinely harder for bag-HDC. Predicts: more synonym-rich corpora (e.g. dark_sector_ring_down_age, ndjson_over_json) cluster tighter.

finding: The 3 highest BETWEEN-cohort similarities were precisely the known semantically-related cohort pairs from MEMORY: (fiber_spatially_absent ↔ time_as_shadow ↔ cascade_lives_on_circles) — all members of the shadow-stance family per [[user_stance_identity_not_implementation_discipline]]; and (vocab_14_AN_intact ↔ kepler_shape_universal) — both about primitive classes. Encoder naturally surfaces the project's known semantic clusters without being told they exist.
note: These 'between-cohort' similarities (0.07-0.08) are still below the within-cohort baseline (0.20 mean) — the bag fingerprint preserves both within-stance similarity AND across-shadow-stance-family kinship as distinct signal levels.

method: log-odds-ratio user vs baseline (Monroe et al. 2008), HDC XOR delta (Class M bind), Class L spectral delta

Absolute-delta threshold (0.05) was too coarse. Per-canon binary test (which corpus is closer) shows 80% favors user lexicon — robust statistical signal.
